Saidie Quinn Newara
XR UI/UX concept designer · Graphics & UI concepts
Pittsburgh, PA · official_emmi@outlook.com · github.com/pfn000 · X @SaidieQN


PROFILE
Graphics and UI/UX concept designer working across visual identity, spatial interfaces, illustration and
interactive worlds. Put me in a room with a bunch of geniuses and nerds and I can quickly sketch up
concepts for their UIs and UXs, then prototype them in XR.


EXPERIENCE

Code Development — Resonite                                                                     Nov 2022 – Jan 2025
Freelance & Dev Volunteer · Yellow Dog Man Studios
Worked privately with FrooxEngine to help develop and migrate the game engine graphics & logic code from
"ProtoFlux" to "LogiX". Focused on prototyping, coding, troubleshooting, private collaboration, and handling
legally licensed code. Promoted LogiX, tutored, trained, and mentored future team members and moderators.
Ran an open call push-chain when shipping patches and testing, and assisted with C# and game development in
open-ended co-work through the platform transition.

Founder — EmmiCO (3D & Commissions)                                                            Feb 2020 – May 2023
EmmiCO Systems · Fiverr Contracts & Commissions · Pittsburgh, PA · Remote
Self-established studio building custom 3D modeling commissions and virtual content. Delivered contracted 3D
work through Fiverr using Unity, the VRChat Creator Companion SDK, Blender, VSCode, and the Meta Quest
SDK / Quest 3 Pro headset.
